summary: Design safer complaint workflows, referrals and feedback analysis. Explore this practical humanitarian training course and review the outline.
lede: Humanitarian feedback and complaints management helps accountability, programme and MEAL teams run safe, closed-loop response systems. They practise creating intake and referral workflows, applying consent and triage criteria, and setting response and closure standards. They also build case logs and analyse feedback trends in Excel, using CHS and IASC AAP commitments as reference points.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for receiving, routing, resolving or learning from feedback and complaints in humanitarian and development programmes. It suits people who need to connect community-facing channels with programme quality, safeguarding and protection procedures.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: experience in humanitarian or development programme delivery, MEAL, protection, safeguarding or community engagement. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s feedback channels and referral procedures if available; sensitive case files are not needed for course exercises.
